title: WildSprout: SkyLands
description: generates big(ish) sky islands that could fit more fantasy minecraft players or create aeronautics
body:
# WildSprout: Skylands
A mod that adds floating islands meant for use in modpacks with create aeronautics to have some extra spice in normal worlds

## FEATURES
- sky islands
they generate as (decently rare) structures in the sky
![wildsprout skylands](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5d70d037-a454-474f-8ec5-e740fd94b6ae)



## INCLUDED BIOMES
- all vanilla biomes

## CONFIGURATION
check the config folder
- max height the island can generate at
- min height the island can generate at
